scope: r29 portable validation for the Windows HDR pre-Present guard. r28 proved the swap-chain containing output could remain stale across Win+Alt+B; r29 instead uses a private native DXGI factory, refreshes it when IsCurrent() becomes false, enumerates the output matching Control's current monitor, and samples IDXGIOutput6::GetDesc1() before the real Present. The r27 resize-side quiesce fallback and r26 two-fresh-frame warmup are retained.

tests.policy_normal: PASS r29 fresh-output HDR guard policy: pre-resize domain gate, bridge handoff, resize fallback, and two-fresh-frame warmup retained
tests.policy_asan_ubsan: PASS r29 fresh-output HDR guard policy: pre-resize domain gate, bridge handoff, resize fallback, and two-fresh-frame warmup retained
tests.source_contract: PASS private native IDXGIFactory1 IsCurrent refresh + adapter/output enumeration + monitor match + IDXGIOutput6 GetDesc1; observer body contains no swapChain->GetContainingOutput call

assertions: The Windows HDR observer no longer obtains its dynamic output state from IDXGISwapChain::GetContainingOutput().
A missing, stale, or monitor-mismatched private DXGI factory/output causes a native factory recreation and current-monitor output enumeration.
A detected SDR/HDR display-domain flip queues DLSS-G off before the same real Present and holds it off until the HDR bridge generation advances.
The committed-Present ResizeBuffers quiesce remains a fallback if the OS-led pre-Present detector does not fire.
Two fresh fully tagged frames in the new HDR/SDR domain are still required before FG can re-enable.
RR and the signed-off r24 HDR HUDless/UI recomposition path are unchanged.
